requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING reports mode support for X kind and set-mode ability
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(ROUND_VALUE, X) is true exactly for real kind type parameters for which the processor supports the rounding mode defined by ROUND_VALUE, including the ability to change the mode by CALL IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE(ROUND_VALUE), and false otherwise.

pending.ieee-support-rounding-kind-mode-inquiry: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(mode,x) for each named rounding-mode constant used by the fixture and for default plus selected nondefault real variables; true branch performs the set-mode facet, false branch records an unsupported skip, and mutation inverts the recorded logical result.
pending.ieee-support-rounding-true-branch-set-mo: Probe concrete calls IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(mode,1.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_UP,1.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_DOWN,1.5), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5). Supported branch uses named set-restore preamble rounding-mode-change: save original with IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE, set mode and immediately call IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE to assert the changed value equals mode, restore original with IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE(original), then call IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE again and assert the restored value equals original. Arithmetic branch sets IEEE_DOWN, GET-confirms IEEE_DOWN, computes a = one/three from same-kind variables one=1.0 and three=3.0 to avoid constant folding, sets IEEE_UP, GET-confirms IEEE_UP, computes b = one/three from variables, and under concrete IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5) guarding operands a, b, one and the IEEE_NEXT_AFTER result kind asserts b > a and b == IEEE_NEXT_AFTER(a,one), exactly one ulp apart. Restore original and GET-confirm it after the arithmetic branch. Unsupported branch records skip. Mutations omit the changed GET, restored GET, or replace IEEE_NEXT_AFTER(a,one).

requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING without X reports all-real mode support
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(ROUND_VALUE) is true exactly when IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(ROUND_VALUE, X) is true for all real X, and false otherwise.

pending.ieee-support-rounding-no-x-all-real-rela: For each valid IEEE_ROUND_TYPE mode used by the fixture, generate scalar representatives for every available real kind from ISO_FORTRAN_ENV REAL_KINDS, statically instantiating each kind as REAL(0.0,kind); assert IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(mode) .EQV. ALL of the instantiated IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(mode,REAL(0.0,kind)) results. This checks both directions: no-X true entails every X-form true, and all X-forms true entails no-X true. Mutation drops one kind-specific conjunct.
